title: Peculiar DNA partial threading intercalative ability of tetradentate copper complex based on ONO hydrazone backbone and an ancillary ligand.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究四齿铜配合物与DNA的穿线嵌入结合模式，含分子对接但非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作建模。
abstract: Multidentate copper metal complexes have been in the limelight in the area of DNA interaction studies exhibiting intercalation, groove binding and cross linking modes. Design of metal complex based on the versatile ligands decides their mode of DNA binding behavior. Based on this, a tetradentate Copper (II) complex, [Cu(L)(4,4'-bpy)], is synthesized using ONO hydrazone ligand and ancillary ligand, 4,4'-bipyridine. It is characterized by physico-chemical and UV-Visible, FTIR, Mass and EPR spectroscopic techniques. The binding pattern of the characterized complex with DNA has been assessed by UV absorption and fluorescence spectral titrations as well as viscosity studies and it has exhibited peculiar threading intercalation. The binding constant, K(b) value of the synthesized complex was found to be (4.38 +/- 0.09) x 10(4) M(-)(1), greater than that of the hydrazone ligand (K(b) = 2.29 x 10(4) M(-1)) and lesser than the classical intercalator ethidium bromide - EtBr (K(b) = 10(7)). The fluorescence quenching assays in the presence of ethidium bromide and viscometric studies show threading intercalative mode of binding of the complex to the DNA base pairs. Molecular docking studies further supports such a binding pattern with the bipyridine ring of the complex intercalating with deoxycytosine nucleobase of DNA. ADME (Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism and Excretion) parameters of the complex and ligand were predicted to get an idea of drug likeliness and to correlate the structural properties with semi DNA intercalative pattern of the same.
abstract_zh: 多齿铜金属配合物在DNA相互作用研究领域备受瞩目，展现出嵌入、沟槽结合及交联等模式。基于多功能配体的金属配合物设计决定了其DNA结合行为模式。据此，利用ONO腙配体及辅助配体4,4'-联吡啶合成了一种四齿铜(II)配合物[Cu(L)(4,4'-bpy)]。通过物理化学方法及紫外-可见光谱、傅里叶变换红外光谱、质谱和电子顺磁共振光谱技术对其进行了表征。通过紫外吸收和荧光光谱滴定以及粘度研究评估了该配合物与DNA的结合模式，并表现出独特的穿线嵌入作用。合成配合物的结合常数K(b)值为(4.38 ± 0.09) × 10(4) M(-)(1)，高于腙配体（K(b) = 2.29 × 10(4) M(-1)），但低于经典嵌入剂溴化乙锭 - EtBr（K(b) = 10(7)）。在溴化乙锭存在下的荧光猝灭实验及粘度测定研究表明，该配合物以穿线嵌入模式与DNA碱基对结合。分子对接研究进一步支持了这种结合模式，其中配合物的联吡啶环嵌入DNA的脱氧胞嘧啶碱基。预测了配合物和配体的ADME（吸收、分布、代谢和排泄）参数，以了解其药物相似性，并将其结构特性与半DNA嵌入模式相关联。
